title: MORABO sofa with chaise
description: MORABO sofa with chaise, Gunnared light green/metal Warm and welcoming, neat and stylish. The supporting seat cushions, the cover’s soft finish and the tight fit gives this sofa a perfect balance between its comfort, functions and look. Removable armrests make it easy to add on a chaise lounge.
